jobs.title: January 2027 Coal and Coke Quality Co-op (Engineering/Geology)
jobs.description_text: Start Date: January 2027 Duration: 8 to 12 months What we offer: At EVR, we're dedicated to supporting our workforce on their unique career journeys. The Technical Marketing team is a small technical group consisting of both engineers and geologists who are responsible for ensuring coal and coke quality is on spec for all EVR customers. The team collaborates with mine planning, operations, processing, logistics and marketing to ensure that both current and future state coal and coke quality is understood. Technical marketing is also responsible for bulk testing of coal, and developing all EVR product specifications for delivery to the markets. The Technical Marketing team represents EVR with global coal standard committees such as CISERA, ASTM and ISO. The team also conducts all research studies within EVR on the impact of external factors such as weathering or chemical addition, on coal and coke quality.

jobs.title: Manager, Supply Chain
jobs.description_text: What we offer: At EVR, we're dedicated to supporting our workforce on their unique career journeys. We also believe that our employees are the reason we are accomplishinggreat things and are committed to supporting them through our many different programs. About the role: As part of a business change to move Supply Chain Management from a Centralized Model to a Centre-Led Model, an exciting opportunity exists for Supply Chain Management senior leaders to fill 4 new roles at the operations and lead to site Warehouse, Procurement and Contracts teams, supported by the centralized team. Reporting to the General Manager(s), the Manager(s), Supply Chain is responsible for the integrated delivery and management of Purchasing, Contracts, Warehousing and Contractor Management functions at an EVR Mine Site. As Creative Director / Head of Internal Agency, you will set the creative standard for how EQ Bank shows up every day: in product stories, owned channels, social, editorial, presentations, partner materials and the internal work that helps teams move faster. The studio’s job is to do more than move requests through the system; it should raise the quality, clarity and distinctiveness of the work EQ Bank puts into the world. The ambition is to make EQ Bank’s everyday creative output feel as considered and distinctive as its biggest brand moments. You will lead the ideas, craft, people and operating rhythm that turn business priorities into work people actually notice, understand and want to engage with.

jobs.title: Credit Coordinator
jobs.description_text: Why Join EQ — and Why This Role at Bennington Financial Corp Matters At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. About This Role: EQ × Bennington Financial Corp Partnership This position is being recruited by EQ on behalf of our wholly owned subsidiary, Bennington Financial Corp. Bennington Financial Corp plays a critical role within EQ's ecosystem, specializing in commercial equipment financing and leasing. It extends EQ’s reach beyond traditional banking into a highly specialized and fast-growing segment of the financial services landscape. Joining Bennington means: Being part of the EQ family, with the stability, scale, and purpose of a leading Canadian challenger bank, Working within a specialized, entrepreneurial business where your contributions are highly visible and impactful, Supporting a business that operates at the intersection of bank-grade governance and commercial finance agility, Helping shape compliance, risk, and operational excellence in a business that directly enables Canadian companies to grow This role offers the best of both worlds: the backing, resources, and long-term vision of EQ, combined with the pace, ownership, and influence that comes from working within a focused subsidiary like Bennington. If you’re looking for an opportunity where your expertise matters, your voice is heard, and your work directly supports both innovation and growth—Bennington Financial Corp, powered by EQ, is a compelling place to build your next

jobs.title: Director, Change Enablement
jobs.description_text: The Work The Director, Change Enablement advances EQ Bank’s enterprise Change Enablement practice, a standing capability within People & Talent accountable for readiness, adoption and sustained behaviour change across the Bank’s concurrent transformation agenda. The role closes the gap between funded transformation delivery and the employee readiness required to realize value across enterprise AI, PC Financial integration and convergence, and the EQB 2.0 operating model. Reporting to the Vice President, Talent, Transformation & Design, the incumbent owns the enterprise change method, demand prioritization, adoption readiness and executive-level visibility of change saturation. The mandate is to identify, plan, sequence and land change with the business, making adoption an engineered outcome rather than a communications task applied at go-live.

jobs.title: Director, Strategy, Risk and Business Operations
jobs.description_text: The Work Reporting to the VP, Decumulation, the Director, Strategy, Risk & Business Operations is responsible for leading the strategic planning, business performance and enablement, governance, and risk management functions for the Reverse Mortgage and Insurance Lending business. Acting as the operational and strategic leader to the VP, Decumulation, this role ensures the business maintains a robust risk and control environment while delivering on growth, profitability, and customer objectives. The Director will oversee enterprise and business-specific risk activities including risk appetite monitoring, credit, operational, compliance, legal, conduct, model, and reputational risks. This leader will act as the primary liaison between the business and corporate Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Audit, Governance and other business related risk functions such as Fraud Management while ensuring the business meets all regulatory, governance, and board reporting obligations. In addition, the Director will lead annual strategic planning, financial forecasting, business performance management, executive and Board reporting, KPI development, , enterprise initiatives, business enablement programs, and the development of new products and growth opportunities. The role requires a unique combination of strategic leadership, analytical rigor, operational execution, governance expertise, and cross-functional influence.

jobs.title: Financial Operations Administrator
jobs.description_text: The Work Reporting to the Director, Business Reporting and Settlement, the Financial Operations Administrator is responsible for supporting Equitable Bank's banking operations, payment processing activities, expense management administration, operational controls, reporting, and business continuity activities. The role is responsible for the administration of the Bank's corporate banking platforms, execution and monitoring of payment transactions, maintenance of banking infrastructure and access controls, administration of the Concur expense management platform, and support of Finance and Accounting operational activities. The incumbent acts as a key liaison with banking service providers and internal stakeholders to ensure banking transactions, reporting, and operational processes are executed accurately, efficiently, and in accordance with established policies and controls.

jobs.title: Intern - Commercial Lending AI Engineer, Winter 2027
jobs.description_text: Work Term: January - April 2027 The Intern - Commercial Lending AI Engineer supports the design, development, testing, and support of RESTful APIs, ETL integrations, Power Platform–based solutions, and emerging AI‑enabled capabilities within the Commercial Lending Technology team. This includes supporting AI integrations, large language model (LLM)–powered workflows, intelligent agents, and automated business processes. The role contributes to the delivery of secure, scalable, and reusable interoperability and microservice solutions that support the bank’s digital payment capabilities.

jobs.title: Intern - Commercial Portfolio Management, BES, Winter 2027
jobs.description_text: Work Term: January - April 2027 As part of a growing and dynamic Commercial Portfolio Management team, the Intern - Commercial Portfolio Management, BES will be responsible for determining the information and documents required for annual review and coordinating their collection with direct clients and lending partners for both BES and CFG credit teams, maintaining the annual reviews pipeline reporting, overseeing the site inspection process for both annual review and renewals, including maintaining the site inspection pipeline reporting, following up with assignees and assistance with review of site inspections received and supporting coverage of Renewal Coordinator functions (vacation coverage), which include communications with clients, brokers and lending partners, daily reporting and administering of renewals/extensions as requested by management. The Incumbent will be reporting to the Manager, Commercial Credit, Portfolio Management and will be working closely with the Renewal Coordinator, Account Managers and CFG Portfolio team.

jobs.title: Intern - Credit Risk, Winter 2027
jobs.description_text: Work Term: January - April 2027 The Intern, Credit Risk Scoring, supports the development, monitoring, validation, and optimization of credit risk and account management scorecards across the customer lifecycle. Through the analysis of customer, portfolio, and performance data, the Intern generates insights, reporting, and recommendations that support scorecard development, risk management, model governance, and business decision-making.

jobs.title: Intern - Data Scientist, Winter 2027
jobs.description_text: Work Term: January - April 2027 The Data Science Co-op assists in transforming data into actionable insights that support customer growth and business objectives. The role contributes to customer analytics, predictive modeling, and performance measurement initiatives that help personalize customer journeys, improve marketing and channel effectiveness, and identify opportunities to enhance customer engagement and profitability.

jobs.title: Intern - F2F Sales Enablement, Winter 2027
jobs.description_text: Work Term: January - April 2027 The Co-op Student, F2F Sales Enablement supports the Operations & Enablement team in delivering operational excellence across Equitable Bank's Face-to-Face Acquisition channel. The role provides analytical, operational, compliance, and project support while contributing to business-as-usual activities and strategic initiatives. The position assists with internal process reviews, business reporting, asset management improvements, data analysis, go-to-market launches, promotional campaigns, and other priorities that support the effectiveness and growth of the channel.

jobs.title: Intern - Financial Analyst, Starting Fall 2026
jobs.description_text: Work Term: January 2027 (4, 8 or 12months) As a Financial Analyst Intern, you will be supporting the accounting processes for PC Bank and PC Insurance payroll, expense reports and intercompany transactions as well as the month end processes for PC insurance entities. This includes the booking of journal entries, performing monthly reconciliations and processing payroll vendor payments on time and accurately. To fulfill these tasks, the role would require active coordination with Payroll, Treasury , other finance teams and vendors as required

jobs.title: Intern - Funding Support, Winter 2027
jobs.description_text: Work Term: January - April 2027 The Residential Funding Support role ensures the seamless completion of the mortgage closing process by providing accurate and comprehensive data and documentation to the closing service provider. This enables solicitors/agents to initiate the property purchase or mortgage refinance closing process. Following the disbursement of funds, the incumbent will perform various administrative functions and finalize the setup of the loan within the mortgage system.

jobs.title: Intern - Modern Workplace Analyst, Winter 2027
jobs.description_text: Join a Challenger At EQB, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Work Term: September 2026 - December 2026 The Work: We are seeking a Modern Workplace Analyst Intern to join our Modern Workplace team at Canada’s Challenger Bank. As an intern, you'll play a vital role in supporting and improving the user experience across various endpoints within the bank, including laptops, mobile devices, and cloud solutions. Your focus will be on enhancing end-user experiences and streamlining service delivery processes to minimize incidents related to planned changes. As a member of the Modern Workplace team, you will also collaborate and partner with different stakeholders to create policies, processes, and application deployments that meet the goals of the Digital Workspace Strategy.

jobs.title: Intern - Office Experience and Facilities Winter 2027
jobs.description_text: Work Term: January 2027 (4, 8 or 12months) The Office Experience & Facilities Intern supports the Office Experience team by assisting with facilities operations, workplace projects, office administration, and workplace planning initiatives. The role offers hands-on exposure to corporate facilities management, project coordination, workplace strategy, vendor management, and office operations within a fast-paced financial services environment. A key focus of this role will be supporting major workplace initiatives, including the completion and ongoing optimization of the 25 Ontario office environment, while ensuring day-to-day facilities operations are delivered efficiently and effectively.

jobs.title: Intern - PC Mastercard Lifecycle Management & Partnerships, Winter 2027
jobs.description_text: Work Term: January - April 2027 The PC Mastercard team is seeking a Co-op Student to support its dynamic, fast-paced Lifecycle Management & Partnerships team. The role supports key initiatives across customer lifecycle management, engagement and retention programs, and strategic partner relationship management. It works cross-functionally with Digital, Marketing, Product, Data, and external partners to support initiatives that enhance the customer experience and drive engagement for no-fee and Insiders credit cards. The successful candidate will gain exposure to customer lifecycle strategy, partnership management, data analysis, performance reporting, and cross-functional project coordination while contributing to customer and business outcomes.

jobs.title: Intern - Residential Lending Strategy, Winter 2027
jobs.description_text: Work Term: January - April 2027 The Residential Lending Strategy Intern will be responsible for supporting Mortgage Retention and HELOC strategies and initiatives to drive maximum customer retention and growth of our Home Equity Line of Credit (HELOC) product. They will contribute alongside cross functional teams to support overall strategy and direction of the business unit. The successful candidate will use analytical abilities to provide both qualitative and quantitative input supporting the development of recommendations to drive strategy and growth.

jobs.title: Intern - Retail Lending AI Engineer, Winter 2027

jobs.title: Intern - Risk Analyst, Enterprise Risk Governance & Transformation, Winter 2027
jobs.description_text: Work Term: January - April 2027 Reporting to the Director, Risk Reporting, the Risk Analyst supports Enterprise Risk Governance & Transformation, with most of the role focused on Risk Reporting and AI-enabled process improvement. The Risk Analyst will help prepare risk reports, work with data, support automation opportunities, and assist with governance and transformation activities across Enterprise Risk. This role is designed for a candidate who is comfortable working with data, technology, and business stakeholders. The Risk Analyst will help make risk information easier to prepare, review, and use by supporting reporting processes, building AI-enabled tools, preparing clear analysis and presentations, documenting procedures, and coordinating inputs from different teams.

jobs.title: Intern - Sales Operations & Strategy Associate Winter 2027
jobs.description_text: Work Term: Winter 2027 The Sales Operations & Strategy Associate, Intern supports the Sales Operations & Strategy team with reporting, analysis, operational coordination and process improvement initiatives that enable the Sales organization. The intern will work with the team and cross-functional partners to maintain accurate information, prepare business insights, coordinate recurring deliverables and improve how work is tracked, documented and completed. The role will also support the responsible use of approved artificial intelligence, automation and digital tools to improve recurring activities. All outputs must be reviewed for accuracy, completeness, confidentiality and appropriate business use.

jobs.title: Intern - Technology Workplace Services, Winter 2027
jobs.description_text: Join a Challenger At EQB, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. In addition to the core functions, the incumbent will also perform the technology side of the relocation of staff and be the first point of contact for all technological issues from both phones and internal ticket system.

jobs.title: Intern - Treasury Analyst, Winter 2027
jobs.description_text: Work Term: January - April 2027 Reporting to the Senior Treasury Manager, the Treasury Analyst will be responsible for the execution of processes supporting the bank’s nominee broker deposit issuances, including pricing, payments, and managing key GIC life-cycle events. Furthermore, the individual will support other day-to-day treasury operations for the bank as well as various ad-hoc analyses. This role offers a great opportunity to deliver value by managing key Treasury operations while developing broader Treasury subject matter expertise.

jobs.title: Intern, AI Adoption Operations, Jan - Dec 2027
jobs.description_text: Work Term: January - December 2027 This role supports the AI Centre of Enablement in driving enterprise AI adoption and operational excellence. The intern will play a hands-on role in coordinating AI training programs (White Belt, Blue Belt, Black Belt, Executive Belt), managing certification tracking and assignment, organizing training workshops with vendors and internal facilities, and creating and executing internal communication campaigns. This position provides direct exposure to enterprise AI strategy, governance, and change management within a regulated financial services environment.

jobs.title: Intern, Business Analyst (PC Insurance), Winter 2027
jobs.description_text: Work Term: January - April 2027 This internship will provide a unique opportunity to learn and contribute across the Product, Marketing, and Digital teams within PC Insurance. The successful candidate will support a variety of business activities, including competitive intelligence and market research, governance and action management for key forums, invoice coordination and tracking, dashboard reporting, and strategic project analysis. The role will also provide hands-on exposure to marketing execution through CRM initiatives, customer lifecycle programs, campaign quality assurance, and enterprise asset development, while offering opportunities to build digital capabilities by supporting SEO initiatives and learning digital optimization practices such as Meta tagging. Through this broad range of responsibilities, the successful candidate will gain valuable experience in strategy, operations, marketing, and digital execution within a dynamic insurance business.

jobs.title: Lead AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description_text: Purpose of the Job: The Lead AI Platform Engineer is accountable for technical leadership, engineering excellence, reliability, operability, and the controlled enablement of the organization’s enterprise AI platforms. This role provides hands-on technical leadership across AI platform design, implementation, automation, observability, and production readiness. The incumbent ensures AI platform services and solutions are secure, resilient, observable, supportable, and compliant with enterprise standards for reliability, security, platform management, monitoring, incident coordination, and governance control enforcement. The incumbent acts as a senior technical lead for platform engineering activities, guiding implementation decisions, establishing engineering patterns, mentoring team members, and partnering with cross-functional stakeholders to enable the safe and scalable adoption of AI across the enterprise.

jobs.title: Manager, Commercial Portfolio Management (BES)
jobs.description_text: The Work The Manager, Commercial Portfolio Management will be a key member of the Commercial Credit team, reporting to the Director, Commercial Portfolio Management. The incumbent will be responsible for mentoring and providing guidance to team members while ensuring the team operates efficiently and effectively, providing optimum service. Key responsibilities include, prudent oversight of the BES portfolio, adjudicating credit requests including ensuring credit risk is assessed thoroughly, adhering to established policies, procedures, and meeting compliance and control requirements.

jobs.title: Manager, Risk Data & Model Implementation
jobs.department: Risk and AML/ATF Data, Analytics & Insight
jobs.description_text: The Work The Manager, Risk Data & Model Implementation (“MDMI”) reports to the Senior Manager, Risk Data & Model Implementation (“SMRDMI”), and supports the SMRDMI, the Senior Director, Risk Data & Model Operations and other Senior Management concerning all aspects of Enterprise Risk Management (“ERM”) activities within the Bank under the aspects of Model Implementation (“MI”) with the risk management function. The Manager will play a crucial role in supporting the model implementation and risk delivery, and shape its future in the Bank. With the multidisciplinary nature of this role, the ideal candidate is expected to have a solid understanding of Credit Risk Model development and delivery, data management pipeline and their related technologies. The role will be accountable for delivering implementation specifications and conduct production data assessment for any model implementations for EQB’s Advanced Internal Ratings Based (“AIRB”) approach for Pillar I regulatory capital models, the Internal Capital Adequacy Assessment Process (“ICAAP”) for Pillar II credit risk models, for IFRS 9 provisioning. This role will play a crucial supporting role in building an efficient way to implement risk models and risk reporting data within Equitable Bank.

jobs.title: Regional Director, Regional Sales
jobs.description_text: The Work The Regional Director, Regional Sales is responsible for leading and managing a team of front-line sales members across a defined region. This role drives origination growth through broker relationships and is accountable for revenue and volume targets across Alternative and Reverse Mortgage portfolios. The incumbent ensures consistent execution of sales strategy, broker engagement, and market share growth aligned to national objectives.

jobs.title: Securitization Administration Manager - Contract position.
jobs.description_text: The Manager, Securitization Administration will be responsible for the effective and efficient accounting and reporting of the Bank’s securitization programs. Responsibilities will include executing new securitization issuances and ongoing administration, preparing monthly investor reports, accounting, and financial analysis. This role requires the individual to possess a high degree of knowledge, experience, and well developed interpersonal, communication and leadership skills. The role will require comprehensive skills to interpret and analyze financial data. The position will also require a candidate to have experience in the area of data and systems management. The Manager, Securitization will work closely with internal and external stakeholders including the Bank’s Accounting group, Capital Markets and Treasury departments, CMHC, Computershare, strategic business partners, third party service providers, and the Bank’s external auditors. Strong organization and multi-tasking skills are a must. The individual should be able to work independently, take initiative, and have good attention to detail.

jobs.title: Senior Director, AI Enablement & Platforms
jobs.description_text: The Work The Senior Director, AI Enablement & Platforms is a senior enterprise leader within the Enterprise AI team, accountable for making approved AI capabilities accessible, governed, reliable, supportable and adoptable at scale across EQB. The role leads enterprise AI enablement and adoption, and provides stewardship of the platforms and operating services that underpin a trusted employee and developer experience. The role sets the strategy and operating model for AI platform onboarding, access, service management, support, reliability, observability, lifecycle management, vendor coordination and cost transparency. It partners with Data & AI Governance, AI Engineering, AI Architecture, Cybersecurity, Risk, Privacy, Legal, Infrastructure and business teams to scale AI responsibly and securely without duplicating their accountabilities. The role leads the Manager, AI Platform Operations and Manager, AI Enablement, combining operational excellence with workforce readiness, learning pathways, reusable enablement patterns, communities of practice, communications and stakeholder engagement. Success is measured through responsible adoption, service health, user experience, control effectiveness, productivity and demonstrable business value—not through hands-on solution engineering or innovation-lab delivery.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Financial Planning and Analysis
jobs.description_text: The Work The Senior Director, Financial Planning and Analysis leads the Bank’s enterprise financial planning, forecasting, performance analysis, and management reporting activities and oversees the Financial Planning & Analysis Centre of Excellence within the VP, Financial Planning & Analysis portfolio. The role establishes an integrated view of financial performance, outlook, risks, and opportunities to support executive decision-making and disciplined resource and capital allocation. The role partners with business and functional leaders to translate strategic priorities into financial plans, challenge assumptions, assess performance drivers, and provide timely, decision-useful insight. It is accountable for the quality, consistency, governance, and continuous improvement of planning and forecasting processes and for establishing a high-performing Financial Planning & Analysis Centre of Excellence that scales common standards, tools, models, data, and insight across the Bank.

jobs.title: Senior Financial Analyst, FP&A
jobs.description_text: The Work This opportunity will play a pivotal role within the Financial Planning and Reporting team in one of the fastest growing financial institutions in Canada. The Senior Financial Analyst will use his or her financial modeling and analytical skills to develop scheduled and ad hoc reports that drive key management decisions. The candidate must be a quick learner who possesses strong communication, analytical and technical skills.

jobs.title: Senior Incident, Problem & Change Specialist
jobs.description_text: The Work One of our goals is to fail small and learn fast. The Senior Incident, Problem & Change Specialist will focus on minimizing the impacts of production incidents while ensuring the organization learns quickly to become more resilient. The Incident, Problem & Change Specialist is accountable for tracking, and managing technology incidents experienced within the bank, while driving the restoration of services at pace. A key part of this role is effective communication across all stakeholders and teams within the bank, in both verbal and written form while working under pressure at a fast pace. The role is responsible for managing the processes, guidelines, standards and tools related to Major and other high priority Incidents. This encompasses performing Root Cause Analysis. The role is responsible for managing the lifecycle of Problems, with the aim of preventing incidents from happening or reoccurring. The Incident, Problem & Change Specialist will record and manage problems through to resolution by performing root cause analysis, coordinating third party analysis, and communicating with stakeholders. They will ensure workaround and solution suitability will establish service level objectives, indicators and agreements (SLOs, SLIs and SLAs) for critical systems and channels, including championing automated monitoring and data aggregating to streamline reporting of metrics. This role is also responsible for managing the lifecycle of Changes with the goal of ensuring app

jobs.title: Senior Manager, BES, Portfolio Management
jobs.description_text: The Work The Senior Manager, BES, Portfolio Management will be a key member of the Commercial Credit team, reporting to the Director, BES, Portfolio Management. The incumbent will be responsible for mentoring and providing guidance to team members while ensuring the team operates efficiently and effectively in the prudent underwriting of complex conventional commercial mortgage loans secured by major asset classes in markets throughout Canada. Commercial mortgage loans range in size and up to $5.0 million. Key responsibilities include prudent oversight of the BES portfolio, ensuring credit risk is thoroughly assessed and within the Bank’s risk appetite. Additionally, the incumbent is responsible for ensuring that ongoing loan monitoring, annual reviews, renewals, and amendments/modifications are reviewed and assessed within approved guidelines. Along with the BES Portfolio Manager and the Director, the Senior Manager will monitor the renewal and annual review pipeline reports, manage credit flow and approve or recommend commercial mortgage renewals and annual reviews according to assigned delegation of authority. In addition, the Senior Manager will support the Bank’s goal of delivering a superior customer experience by proactively addressing issues as they arise while ensuring that team members complete underwriting assignments quickly and efficiently.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Events Strategy
jobs.description_text: The Work The Senior Manager, Events Strategy is responsible for leading the strategic direction, planning, execution, measurement and optimization of EQ Bank's event and sponsorship portfolio across Single Family Lending, Commercial Lending, Deposit Services, EQ Bank and Corporate programs. This role is accountable for establishing events as a business growth channel by developing strategies that strengthen broker relationships, support customer engagement, grow brand awareness, deepen education and drive measurable business outcomes. The Senior Manager, Events Strategy will oversee the national events ecosystem, including conferences, sponsorships, broker education programs, customer-facing events, corporate initiatives and partner engagements. The role will establish event success frameworks, measure return on investment, evaluate channel effectiveness and make recommendations that improve event portfolio performance over time. This role demands strategic thinking, data-driven decision making, strong stakeholder management and leadership capabilities while ensuring exceptional execution and budget stewardship across all programming.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Hedge Accounting & Financial Operations
jobs.description_text: The Work The Senior Manager, Hedge Accounting & Financial Operations is a key member of the Accounting and Finance team. Reporting to the Director, Financial Reporting, Policies and Controls, the role will be responsible for providing monthly analysis for derivatives, hedge accounting and fair valuations. The role works closely with various departments including Treasury, Capital Markets, Corporate Development, and Securitization operations, and is responsible for providing middle-office and back-office functions for securities trading and derivatives including settlements and valuations. The role will also be responsible for financial statement disclosures on derivative financial instruments, including compliance and reporting for IIROC debt transactions. The role will also provide support to the banking operations, procurement, and accounts payable functions within the Financial Operations team.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Lifecycle Management Strategy
jobs.description_text: The Work The Senior Manager, Lifecycle Management Strategy, is the owner of lifecycle strategy for the credit card portfolio. The role defines and executes integrated product, marketing and digital strategies across the cardholder journey to drive onboarding, activation, engagement, product usage, retention, loyalty and long-term customer engagement. Combining product knowledge, deep marketing expertise and business acumen, the Senior Manager translates customer insights, portfolio priorities and market opportunities into an actionable lifecycle roadmap. The role partners closely with Product, Digital, Marketing, Data and Analytics, Operations and Finance and teams to deliver coordinated customer experiences and measurable business outcomes. The successful candidate will possess a unique blend of marketing strategy, product, and analytical expertise, coupled with exceptional relationship-building and influencing skills. Working collaboratively with internal teams and external partners, they will lead the development of customer-centric engagement strategies, align stakeholders around shared business objectives, and identify innovative opportunities to strengthen customer relationships and accelerate portfolio growth.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Model Development
jobs.description_text: The Work The Senior Manager, Risk Analytics, Models & Insights is a senior individual contributor responsible for the development, enhancement, implementation, monitoring, and governance of enterprise credit risk models and analytics solutions. The incumbent will support the development and maintenance of AIRB and IFRS 9 models, deliver risk insights to senior management, and ensure compliance with internal governance and regulatory requirements. The incumbent will lead complex analytical initiatives, drive methodological enhancements, support regulatory and audit activities, and champion the adoption of advanced analytics, automation, and Artificial Intelligence (AI) to improve efficiency, insight generation, and risk management practices across the Bank.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Model Validation
jobs.description_text: The Work The Senior Manager, Model Validation reports to the Director, Model Risk Management, and supports the Director and the VP, Model Risk Management, with respect to all aspects of model validation activities within the Bank. The incumbent is responsible for assisting in the development of strategies to validate models through effective challenge and for executing the related validation procedures. The incumbent will also be responsible for ensuring model risk is appropriately managed in accordance with the Bank’s Model Risk Management Framework and applicable regulatory requirements. This includes models for credit and treasury risk management (such as AIRB and IFRS 9 ECL models, interest), interest rate risk, liquidity, and stress testing approaches used to support ICAAP. The incumbent will be instrumental in fostering relationships with model risk stakeholders. The scope of work includes validating model methodology, evaluating the reasonableness of assumptions, identifying the model effective range of use, limitations, assessing the quality of model inputs, developing benchmark analysis, articulating and communicating identified issues and recommendations, drawing conclusions, and creating model validation reports in accordance to the Bank’s Model Risk Management Framework (MRMF). jobs.title: Senior Manager, Organization Design & Operating Model (18-month contract)
jobs.description_text: The Work Reporting to the Director, Organization Design, the Senior Manager, Organization Design & Operating Model is responsible for independently leading significant organization design and operating model workstreams and developing recommendations for senior leaders with minimal day-to-day oversight. The role partners with business leaders, Human Resources Business Partners and transformation teams to translate strategy into practical organizational solutions that improve organizational effectiveness, decision-making, accountability and business performance. The Senior Manager leads complex work from diagnosis through implementation, including organizational assessments, future-state organization design, operating model design, governance, decision rights, workforce and capability planning, and implementation planning. The role requires deep technical expertise, sound judgment, strong facilitation and the ability to navigate ambiguity while balancing strategic thinking with practical execution.

jobs.title: Staff Engineer, AI Security
jobs.description_text: The Work This role leads the design, implementation, and operation of security controls for Artificial Intelligence (AI), generative AI, machine learning, AI agents, copilots, automation platforms, agentic AI platforms, orchestration frameworks, model providers, and the cloud services that support them. Reporting to the Senior Director, Cyber Security Engineering & Operations and working as a fully dedicated, embedded security partner to the AI Centre of Enablement and the Enterprise Technology, Data & AI organization, the incumbent provides senior technical leadership to ensure AI solutions are delivered securely and in line with enterprise security standards and regulatory expectations. The incumbent develops reusable security patterns, guardrails, control implementations, automation, and detection capabilities that support enterprise AI adoption while protecting the bank from data leakage, model misuse, insecure integrations, excessive permissions, unsafe automation, and unapproved use of AI technologies. The role enables teams through practical, reusable guardrails and secure patterns rather than relying only on review and enforcement. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports.

jobs.title: Syndication Analyst
jobs.description_text: As part of a growing and dynamic Commercial Syndicated Lending team, the Syndication Analyst will support the team in the management of syndicate partner relationships. Responsibilities will include but not be limited to: providing product-specific advice regarding the Bank’s commercial product, educating investors on the Bank’s policies and procedures, and marketing the Bank’s financial solutions to investors through regular ongoing contact. In this role, the Syndication Analyst must be knowledgeable about Equitable Bank’s mortgage products and processes while having a good understanding of the underwriting, risk and compliance guidelines to ensure all files meet industry and company regulatory requirements.

jobs.title: Treasury Analyst
jobs.description_text: The Work The incumbent is responsible for data management (extraction/validation/reporting) to support several key Treasury functions, including hedge accounting activities, derivative valuations, and collateral management. The incumbent will also be involved in asset pricing model maintenance and other ad-hoc projects. The role is in the Treasury group. Equitable Bank’s Treasury group is responsible for directly managing numerous risks within the bank, including the Bank’s funding risk, liquidity risk, interest rate risk, market risk and pricing risk. Treasury partners with businesses to ensure all risks are managed and works closely with finance to ensure activities are appropriately reflected in financial statements. Treasury staff have opportunities for exposure to a variety of business units across the bank and to have an impact on the Bank’s performance.

jobs.title: Vice President, Integration Management Office
jobs.description_text: Purpose of the Job The Vice President, Integration Management Office (IMO) is accountable for the end-to-end execution of the Bank's enterprise integration, bringing two established Canadian banking businesses together into a stronger, more efficient and more competitive combined bank. The IMO holds one integrated master plan, central value case objectives & realization, and a central view of program budget, setting the standards, decision gates, data and reporting that delivery teams work to. The IMO operates through a matrix of employees and consultants across the Bank, with the central programme office team and dedicated consultants reporting directly to the Vice President. This is a cross-bank role. The Integration Management Office is the connective tissue between the Executive Leadership Team, the executive sponsors who own each workstream's outcomes, the Board and its committees, the Bank's regulators, and the vendor providing transition services. The Vice President sets the cadence, the control structure and the reporting spine those audiences rely on, and converts complexity into decisions and execution plans. The role is deliberately broad rather than deep. jobs.title: Senior Commercial Counsel
jobs.description_text: The Role GeoComply is looking for a Senior Commercial Counsel to serve as a key driver across our highest-value revenue agreements and strategic commercial initiatives. In this role, you will act as a trusted legal and business partner to our Executive and GTM leadership, leading novel contract negotiations, navigating privacy and emerging tech regulations, and building scalable legal processes. We are looking for an autonomous, business-minded lawyer who can combine sharp analytical judgment with strong executive presence to protect our interests, mentor junior counsel, and support our rapid global expansion. The typical salary range for this position is from $172,000-$236,500 CAD annually. The base pay offered may vary depending on a variety of factors including, your qualifications, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. In addition to our competitive salary package, we also offer the following personal and professional development benefits: Performance-based bonus Equity plans Paid vacation and sick days Extended health benefits Generous Learning & Development Allowance Sports and Physical Wellness budget (30% of L&D Allowance) Charitable and DEI initiatives Team-building events

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.description_text: Why do we create this position? Infrastructure and hosting are vital to GeoComply’s success, ensuring uninterrupted, top-tier service for the US gaming industry. Beyond that, we engineer forward-thinking infrastructure to deliver high availability, key to our uptime, making it easy to scale, accelerating innovation, and keeping pace with industry growth and evolving customer demands. We are an engineering organization navigating a critical migration and innovation phase. Our goal is to reduce cloud platform dependency, optimize costs, and ensure high availability and scalability by migrating service workloads from AWS to GCP. At the same time, we’re modernizing our systems, shifting from a monolithic architecture to microservices, and building a resilient, multi-region platform. To sustain this pace, we are growing our DevOps capability in Vietnam. This role adds senior hands-on execution capacity to the team. We are looking for someone who can own significant workstreams end to end, mentor the engineers around them, and partner directly with development squads as we scale. Job Description As a Senior DevOps Engineer based in Vietnam and part of a global DevOps team, you'll design, build, and operate the infrastructure and DevOps tooling that powers GeoComply's systems. You'll own meaningful pieces of our AWS to GCP migration and multi-region platform on GCP, contributing to a unified, scalable core infrastructure that enables product development teams to deliver value quickl

jobs.title: Accounting Manager, P2P Operations
jobs.description_text: The Opportunity We’re looking for a Manager, Procure-to-Pay & AP Transformation to lead our Accounts Payable team and build reliable, automated financial operations that can scale with Fullscript. You’ll lead the team responsible for day-to-day AP execution, with your focus on developing people, strengthening controls, and improving the processes and systems behind their work. Working across Finance, Partner Managers, Distribution Centers, and ERP system teams, you’ll help connect purchasing, goods receiving, invoice matching, and vendor payments into an accurate, efficient procure-to-pay process. You’ll thrive here if you’re a people leader with a proven track record of AP transformation in a business that purchases, receives, and sells physical goods. You understand the operational details, see where processes break down, and know how to build better ways of working. Your dedication to excellence will drive meaningful relationships, foster trust, and elevate the overall customer experience, positioning our company as a leader in the industry. jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer - Identity and Access Management (IAM)
jobs.description_text: About Fullscript We’re an industry-leading health technology company on a mission to help people get better. We started in 2011 with one simple idea. When everything they need is in one place, they can focus on what matters most: helping people get better. This is your invitation. Bring your ideas, your grit, and your care for people. Join us and shape the future of care.

jobs.title: Data Quality Intern - Winter 2027

If you enjoy working in a fast-paced, ever-changing and exciting startup environment, then this is the job for you! You'll gain practical experience and may have the opportunity to join our team full-time.

jobs.description_text: Reporting to the Sales Director, you'll own a named account list with some of the country's largest banks and credit unions. These institutions know who we are as Greenlight is the market leader in a rapidly growing youth and family banking category. Many have been in conversation with us. What they need is someone who can reach the executives who own the P&L, build the business case in their numbers, and drive a seven-figure agreement to signature. You're also not starting from a blank page. We’ve spent 4 years building the enterprise playbook: the positioning, the business case, the deal motion. jobs.description_text: Greenlight is seeking a motivated Legal & Compliance Intern for the 2026–2027 school year to support our Legal and Compliance team. This role reports to a Manager, Associate Counsel.

jobs.description_text: Greenlight is looking for a Senior Content Creator who is, first and foremost, a creator. Someone who can spot a trend in the morning, be on camera by lunch, and have it posted before the moment passes and who also knows how to zoom out and build the strategy that makes those posts add up to growth. You're comfortable being the face in the videos, shooting on your phone, editing in-app, and getting something good out the door fast without a production crew. We're looking for someone with a real track record of growing accounts organically. If your best work came from scrappiness rather than spend, we want to see it.

jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Senior Product Designer with a passion for creating great products for great people (in our case the modern family). In this role, you will partner closely with both our IDC office (Bangalore) and the US based design team members contributing to UX/UI direction helping ensure quality and consistency for our product & services. Working alongside partners from Product Management, Engineering, Brand, Marketing, and other core teams, you will help ensure that Greenlight delivers truly lovable and memorable experiences. About the Team We are a collaborative, full-stack Design org with disciplines that span Product Design, Brand Design, Motion Design, Print Design, and Design Program Management. We are led by our VP of Design, Creative Director, and Product Design Director and work closely with our Product, Engineering, and Marketing partners. Our team is critical in helping ensure that Greenlight delivers truly lovable experiences with product and brand expressions that are aligned.

jobs.description_text: Common Platforms builds the foundations every other product team depends on. We're looking for a Senior Product Manager, Common Platforms to own this layer end-to-end: the Identity and access management, the permissions that govern what parents and kids can each do, and the multi-channel notification platform that reaches millions of families every day. This is a high-leverage, high-trust role at the center of Greenlight's platform organization. Your customers are both the families using our products who should never have to think about any of this and the product teams building on top of you, who ship faster when your systems are reliable. You'll work cross-functionally across teams at Greenlight (US & India) , and you'll have direct line-of-sight to executive leadership on the decisions that shape customer trust and platform reliability. The right person thinks in systems, and is comfortable building core platform products. This role reports to the Director of Product and sits within the Common Platforms team.

jobs.description_text: We are seeking a Senior Product Security Engineer to join our growing security team. You will work closely with engineering, product, and operations teams to embed security best practices from design through to deployment. You will play a critical role in shaping our security posture, embedding security into our development lifecycle, and protecting our customers' data.

jobs.description_text: Greenlight is looking for a Staff Offensive Security Engineer for our Security team. This individual will be responsible for the continuous offensive security validation across our consumer digital platforms, mobile applications, cloud infrastructure, internal corporate environments, and emerging hardware device lines. The Staff Offensive Security Engineer will drive the long-term technical strategy for offensive security, lead complex red teaming and multi-stage adversary simulations, manage deep-dive vulnerability research into high-risk areas, champion a culture of security-minded development across the R&D organization, and establish automated security guardrails and self-healing infrastructure within a fintech environment.

jobs.description_text: We are looking for a Supply Chain Manager, Planning & Fufillment to build the demand planning, inventory management, and 3PL fulfillment infrastructure that will enable us to scale across our sales channels. You will sit at the intersection of Operations, Go-to-Market, Finance, Hardware, and our external partners, and you will own initiatives from unearthing data, designing processes, implementing it with partners, and building the dashboards that prove it works. The ideal candidate has planned physical goods across D2C, marketplace, and retail channels at a growth-stage consumer hardware or CPG company, has personally set up and managed a 3PL relationship, and is comfortable creating structure in areas that do not yet have mature ownership.

O teu foco principal será o ecossistema GA4 (Web e Apps), enriquecendo a medição com fontes omnicanal e dados de negócio. Uma parte central do trabalho consiste em compreender o impacto da media nestes dados e gerar insights acionáveis para as equipas de media otimizarem a sua performance. É fundamental ter conhecimentos em atribuição digital e no cruzamento de dados de GA4 com modelos de MMM (Marketing Mix Modeling). jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (EMEA)
jobs.description_text: Immuta is the Data Authorization Company, helping the world’s largest organizations control who, and what, can access their data. The way enterprises access data is fundamentally changing. Organizations are racing to put data to work across analytics and AI, while AI copilots and agents are emerging as an entirely new class of data consumer. Traditional approaches built around tickets, static permissions, and manual approvals were not designed for this speed, scale, or complexity. Immuta provides the authorization layer for modern data and AI. Our platform enables organizations to provision governed access to data by policy, by request, and dynamically for AI agents, so people and AI can access the data they need while enterprises maintain security, compliance, and control. For Chief Data Officers, that means making enterprise data dramatically easier to access and use without giving up governance. For AI leaders, it means giving AI agents secure, governed access to enterprise data so they can move from experimentation into production. Founded in 2015, Immuta is trusted by Fortune 500 companies and government agencies worldwide. Our technology ecosystem includes Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud, Okta, ServiceNow, Teradata, Alation, Atlan, and Starburst — connecting Immuta to the data, cloud, identity, and enterprise platforms powering modern data and AI environments. Immuta has been recognized by Forbes as a top American startup employer, by Inc. Maga

AI makes this challenge even more urgent. As copilots and agents begin to find, request, and access data on behalf of users and increasingly interact with other agents and systems, enterprises need an authorization model built for machine speed and scale. That’s where Immuta comes in. Our Field team helps customers establish Immuta as the data authorization layer for humans and AI, working across the broader data, AI, governance, security, and cloud organizations required to make that vision a reality. jobs.description_text: Team Description: Kitware’s computer vision team is a leader in the creation of cutting-edge algorithms and software for automated image and video analysis. We seek to advance the fields of computer vision and deep learning through research and development and through collaborative projects that build on our open source software platforms. As an Annotation Specialist, you will work on a team of dedicated individuals alongside our R&D Engineers and Researchers to advance the state-of-the-art in computer vision. Annotation is critical to the success of many of our computer vision projects; the annotations are used in scoring and evaluating our work as well as training our algorithms. Kitware’s Annotation team provides the key data annotation support within our computer vision team to meet these needs. The team uses a variety of software tools to label objects, activities, events, and other items of interest in images and video. This is an as-needed, project-dependent position with variable hours. Work availability will ebb and flow based on project needs, and a set number of hours each week is not guaranteed. The position requires flexibility to work on-site at Kitware’s headquarters in Clifton Park, NY when project needs require it, including work in a specialized facility. We seek to advance the fields of computer vision and deep learning through research and development and through collaborative projects that build on our open source software platforms, such as Kitware Image and Video Exploitation and Retrieval (KWIVER) toolkit. About the Projects: The Computer Vision Group is staffed by a multidisciplinary team of world-class experts in computer vision, deep learning, machine learning, and software engineering. We do a lot of development in C++ and Python with some JavaScript for web clients. We use OpenCV, ROS, Boost, Postgres, Caffe, Theano, VXL, and many other open source tools. Kitware develops CMake, VTK, ParaView, ITK, KWIVER, and a number of other open-source toolkits. This is an opportunity to gain experience while contributing to high-level complex problems related to Computer Vision, Machine Learning, and Deep Learning.

In this role, you will work closely with game studios and cross-functional teams to translate marketing plans into actionable tasks, manage timelines, and help deliver campaigns that support business objectives across our games portfolio. The salary will be determined based on your knowledge, skills and competencies, and you’ll have room to grow after you join! jobs.title: Senior Infrastructure Security Specialist
jobs.description_text: As Senior Infrastructure Security Specialist, you will protect Kepler’s corporate, cloud, and operational infrastructure. Reporting to the VP, Information Security & CISO, you will own and improve infrastructure security capabilities, including vulnerability management, security monitoring, endpoint protection, system hardening, and incident response. You will partner with IT, Engineering, Operations, and other teams to reduce security risk while supporting Kepler’s growth. The role also supports regulated and Government of Canada environments that may process Protected or Classified information. This Toronto-based role follows a hybrid model, with approximately 40% of time spent on-site.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Program Manager at Kepler, you will spearhead the development and execution of mission-critical satellite systems from concept through on-orbit validation. You will drive strategic program initiatives that strengthen global partnerships and fuel our continued growth in the space sector. In this crucial role, you will lead a cross-functional team to develop and commission our Tranche-2 satellite constellation. You will serve as a key leader, working in close collaboration with our Engineering and Operations teams to ensure on-time, on-budget execution of programs from initial kickoff through operational handover. In addition to program execution, you may play a pivotal role in proposal efforts - contributing to opportunities involving the development or enhancement of satellite systems, software, satellite commissioning, or on-orbit operations. This role is ideally suited for candidates who bring good technical depth across a range of aerospace engineering disciplines paired with strong program management acumen. The successful candidate will have a proven ability to lead high-performing teams while building effective relationships with external stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Spectrum Engineer
jobs.description_text: As a Senior Spectrum Engineer at Kepler, you will play a leading role in ensuring that our next-generation low-Earth orbit satellite communications systems are designed and operated in alignment with global spectrum regulations. You will integrate regulatory requirements, frequency-coordination considerations, and interference constraints into Kepler’s system architecture, analytical models, and resource-management capabilities. Working under Regulatory and supporting cross-functional teams such as the Systems Engineering, RF, Antenna, Mission Design, and Software teams, you will translate complex International Telecommunication Union (ITU) regulations into practical system requirements and technical solutions. You will lead critical analyses, influence system-level design decisions, and provide technical guidance on spectrum strategy, compliance, and performance optimization.

In order to help advance our goal of bringing revolutionary airships to life, the Avionics Technician will work directly with the appropriate company personnel to organize, plan, and execute the troubleshooting, installation, and inspections of various subsystems. This position will also provide flight operational support as required. The base range for this role is $45-62/hr, which is determined based on experience, geography, and qualifications.

jobs.description_text: We are seeking a Flight Test Engineer to operate within the Flight Test team. Candidate will work with ground and flight operations, engineering, and other LTA teams, to develop test plans and direct flight test efforts for our revolutionary large rigid airship flying from Moffett Field in Sunnyvale, CA. We’re looking for an engineer to foster safe, effective flight testing. The Flight Test Engineer will develop test plans and test hazard analyses (THA), draft airship limitations, lead ground and flight tests, perform data analysis, write test reports, and document test results. This position will also contribute to the development and review of the Airship Flight Manual (AFM) and other operational documents by collaborating with multiple teams to provide pertinent information.

jobs.title: Senior Systems Safety Engineer (CA)
jobs.description_text: LTA is seeking a Systems Safety Engineer to serve as a senior individual contributor and technical authority within the Systems Engineering function. Operating at the principal level, this engineer applies broad mastery across subsystems and disciplines beyond their core area to architect and validate new, complex system-of-systems and integration approaches where no legacy solution exists. The Principal Systems Engineer sets the overarching technical direction for a systems discipline, owns the system-level safety, verification, and certification strategy for a vehicle program or major system, and acts as a subject-matter expert during internal audits and regulatory interactions. This is a role for a proven technical leader who provides leadership and direction to multidisciplinary, integrated product teams, mentors and develops senior engineering staff, shapes program-defining architectures and drives the integration and certification of lighter-than-air flight vehicles. The base salary range for this role is $165,000 - 230,000, which is determined based on experience, geography, and qualifications.
